description: This file defines the IntegrationConfiguration class, which models the configuration details for integrating with external gateways. It includes fields for environment, module code, activation status, keys, and options, along with methods for JSON serialization.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the integration settings with an external gateway, including environment details, activation status, and key-value configurations for the integration.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code identifying the integration module.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for the integration configuration.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the integration configuration is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the integration configuration.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with core information about the integration configuration.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the integration configuration to a JSON string, including keys and options.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the environment (e.g., TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Gets the map of integration options.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if this configuration is the default selection.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether this configuration is the default.
